  "summary": "The function processes input bytes through a custom transformation and returns the bitwise complement of a computed value. It does not use the 'arg', 'out', or 'out_cap' parameters.",
  "proposed_name": "fn_08",
  "algorithm": "unknown",
  "self_confidence": 0.95,
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "A1",
      "type": "CONST",
      "text": "Initial value of 'h' is 0xFFFFFFFF.",
      "asserted_values": ["0xFFFFFFFF"],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "A2",
      "type": "CONST",
      "text": "Magic number used in transformation is 0xF7179BF5.",
      "asserted_values": ["0xF7179BF5"],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "A3",
      "type": "CF",
      "text": "Processes each byte in 'in' with a loop that runs exactly 'len' times.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "A4",
      "type": "CF",
      "text": "Each byte undergoes 8 iterations of a bitwise transformation.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "A5",
      "type": "IO",
      "text": "Returns bitwise complement of 'h' as uint64_t.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "A6",
      "type": "IO",
      "text": "Does not use 'arg' parameter.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "A7",
      "type": "IO",
      "text": "Does not use 'out' or 'out_cap' parameters.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "A8",
      "type": "SIDE",
      "text": "No side effects on input or output buffers.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    }
  ],
  "recovered_c": "#include <stdint.h>\n#include <stddef.h>\n\nuint64_t fn_08(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, uint64_t arg, uint8_t *out, size_t out_cap) {\n  uint32_t h = 0xFFFFFFFF;\n  for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n    h ^= in[i];\n    for (uint8_t b = 0; b < 8; b++) {\n      h = -(h & 1) & 0xF7179BF5 ^ (h >> 1);\n    }\n  }\n  return ~h;\n}"
}
